shared-task-views.title: Synced views
shared-task-views.name: View name
shared-task-views.scope_hint: Save filters, iteration criteria and layout. Sharing never grants access to tasks.
shared-task-views.online: Saved on the server for this project. Sign in on another device to use it.
shared-task-views.empty: No synced views yet. Save your current filters to use them again.
shared-task-views.changed: Current filters differ from this saved view.
shared-task-views.conflict: This view changed elsewhere. Your draft is retained. Load the latest revision to review it, or save a copy.
shared-task-views.unknown: The save result is not confirmed. Retry the same operation before making another change.
shared-task-views.deleted: Synced view deleted. Current filters are unchanged.
shared-task-views.delete_hint: Remove this saved view for everyone who can use it. Tasks and current filters are unchanged.
shared-task-views.denied: Access changed. Synced views have been cleared. Refresh after access is restored.
shared-task-views.readonly: You can use this view or save a personal copy.
shared-task-views.review: Latest revision loaded. Review the saved filters before choosing Update view.
shared-task-views.invalid: Enter a view name of 1–80 characters.
shared-task-views.replace: Update current revision with my draft
shared-task-views.sync_current: Saved views are up to date.
shared-task-views.sync_stale: Couldn’t check for changes. Showing the last loaded views.
shared-task-views.sync_offline: Offline. Showing the last loaded views.
shared-task-views.sync_pending: Sync paused while the save result is unconfirmed.
shared-task-views.update_hint: Your current filters are still active. Review the differences before applying.
shared-task-views.unavailable: This saved view is no longer available. Your current filters are still active. Choose another view or save these filters.
shared-task-views.draft_unavailable: The saved view is no longer available. You can save this draft as a personal copy.
shared-task-views.draft_readonly: Editing access changed. You can still save your draft as a personal copy.
shared-task-views.invalid_response: The saved views could not be verified for this project. Refresh to check again.
